text.p: Mirjana Lucic, an unseeded 15-year-old Croatian playing in her first WTA tennis tournament, won the final at her own country's women's Open on Sunday.
Lucic, who knocked out top seed Amanda Coetzer of South Africa in straight sets in Saturday's semifinal, beat unseeded American Corina Morariu 7-5 6-7 7-6 in the final.
In a match dominated by baseline play, Lucic took the opening set to the delight of the wildly cheering home crowd.

Morariu fought back to level by taking the second set on a tie-break but the American double faulted at match point on another tie-break in the third to give Lucic the title in the $107,500 tournament.
